items.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: See who was playing, Sir Charles Thompson.

ctx.x: Do you think you would have been the right pianist for that band or would you have wanted to play too much for a band of that size?
Both, I guess. . . . See who was playing, Sir Charles Thompson.
Now, I guess Illinois Jacquet was in the band at the time.
